resources.title: Control Systems Stability & Frequency Response Summary Sheet
resources.description: Original handbook summarizing Routh-Hurwitz criteria, Root Locus construction rules, Bode plots, Gain/Phase Margin, and Nyquist stability criterion.
resources.bestFor: Control Systems midterms and GATE EE

resources.title: Transformers & Induction Machines Operating Equations Guide
resources.description: Original study guide covering Transformer equivalent circuits, open/short circuit tests, torque-slip curves, and circle diagram derivations.

resources.title: Power Electronics Converters & Inverters Master Reference
resources.description: Original reference covering Buck, Boost, and Buck-Boost DC-DC converters, SCR commutation, and 3-phase Voltage Source Inverters (VSI) PWM analysis.
resources.bestFor: EV power drives and converter hardware design

resources.title: NPTEL Electrical Machines - I by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. D. Kastha complete video course on single-phase transformers, auto-transformers, DC generator principles, and DC motor speed controls.
resources.bestFor: Core fundamentals of electrical rotating machinery

resources.title: NPTEL Control Engineering by IIT Kanpur
resources.description: Prof. Ramprasad Sengupta covering feedback control, transfer functions, state variable models, and frequency response techniques.

resources.title: NPTEL Power System Analysis by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. A. K. Sinha lectures on per-unit systems, transmission line modeling, Gauss-Seidel and Newton-Raphson load flow, and symmetrical faults.
resources.bestFor: Grid power system analysis and load flow calculations

resources.title: NPTEL Power Electronics by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. D. Kastha comprehensive lectures on power semiconductor devices (IGBT, MOSFET, Thyristor), phase-controlled rectifiers, and DC-DC choppers.

resources.title: MIT 6.061 Introduction to Electric Power Systems
resources.description: MIT OCW course on magnetic circuits, AC power concepts, synchronous generators, transformers, and bulk power transmission lines.

resources.title: NPTEL Fundamentals of Electric Drives by IIT Bombay
resources.description: Prof. B. G. Fernandes covering electric drive dynamics, DC motor four-quadrant operations, scalar V/f induction motor drives, and vector control.
resources.bestFor: Electric vehicle powertrain and motor control

resources.title: NPTEL High Voltage Engineering by IIT Madras
resources.description: Lectures on Townsend breakdown mechanism in gases, liquid and solid dielectric breakdown, impulse voltage generation, and lightning surge arresters.
resources.bestFor: High voltage laboratory and insulation testing

resources.title: NPTEL Power System Protection by IIT Bombay
resources.description: Prof. T. S. Kishore covering protective relaying principles, overcurrent relays, directional relays, differential protection, and distance protection.

resources.title: MIT 2.004 Dynamics and Control II
resources.description: MIT engineering course on state space representations, transfer function models, feedback stabilization, and digital control implementations.
resources.bestFor: Advanced state space and control theory

resources.title: Electrical4U Comprehensive Electrical Engineering Articles
resources.description: Peer-reviewed technical tutorial repository with diagrams covering transformer testing, electrical circuits, motors, and grid switchgear.

resources.title: NPTEL Non-Conventional Energy Resources by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Lectures on solar photovoltaic systems, wind turbine generators, biomass power, and grid integration of renewable energy sources.
resources.bestFor: Renewable energy and smart grid courses

resources.title: NPTEL Basic Electrical Technology by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Foundational course covering Ohm's Law, Kirchhoff's Laws, Thevenin and Norton theorems, AC sinusoidal circuits, and 3-phase power calculations.
resources.bestFor: Electrical circuits analysis and network theorems
